_comment: The golden-task corpus (037, FR-011). Fixed tasks both skill versions run against, so a
behavioural diff describes the CANDIDATE rather than the corpus.
The floor is enforced by core.intake.detonation.assert_corpus_floor and fails rather than
warns: at least 8 tasks, at least 2 attempting a denied tool, at least 1 exercising a
must-deny case. The denial clause is the one that matters most — a corpus that never
provokes a denial cannot detect a candidate that provokes more of them, and would report
a clean comparison for a skill that had learned to reach further.
ADR-0053's honest limit stands: detonation catches only what the corpus provokes. This
floor makes the corpus provoke SOMETHING; it cannot make it provoke everything.
